title: writing-rule-proposal.v1
description: Pending writing-rule proposal drafted from an in-conversation operator correction (Phase 135.4). Human-CLI-only promotion: scripts/writing-rule-approve.sh moves an entry from pending to approved and appends the corresponding writing-rule.v1 record to rules.jsonl. There is no automatic promotion path.

pattern.description: Go regexp (RE2) syntax only — no lookahead/lookbehind/backreferences. Copied verbatim into writing-rule.v1 on approval.

good.description: Suggested good-pattern rewrite, taken from the operator's own correction.

scenes.description: Scene tags this rule would apply to. Empty/absent means all scenes.

evidence.description: The operator's correction that this proposal is drafted from (before/after excerpt).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) the proposal was drafted.

decided_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) the proposal was approved or rejected. Absent while status is pending.
